title: AirPrompter offline bundle (.apbundle)
description: An offline update is the OTA release, serialized (D37): the signed manifest, every payload it references, and the current key-set, with a signed `notAfter`. The file travels by USB stick, artifact repository or email, so it is encrypted to the target's distribution public key (HPKE, D56). A plaintext bundle is a `dev`-target opt-in and never the default. `apply` runs the identical verification path as OTA.

recipientKeyId.description: Thumbprint of the target's X25519 distribution public key (RFC 7638 over {crv, kty, x} of the OKP JWK, hex; registered in the console; generated by `airprompter keygen`).

enc.description: HPKE encapsulated key (RFC 9180 base mode), base64url without padding.

ciphertext.description: AEAD ciphertext of the UTF-8 canonical JSON of the `contents` document, base64url without padding. AAD is the UTF-8 string `<agentId>|<target>` — both known to the recipient before decryption — so a bundle cannot be re-labelled for another agent or target; the generation check happens after decryption, on the manifest.

notAfter.description: Offline lease. After it the runtime is `lease_expired` and follows the target's degrade/halt setting. Bound by the manifest's issuedAt + leaseSeconds unless the target is `syncMode: offline`.

keySet.description: The platform root metadata current when the bundle was pulled; verified against the pinned root exactly as over the air.

countersignKeySet.description: Present on countersign targets so an air-gapped host can verify the countersignatures.

payloads.description: Every content hash the manifest references (slots, steps, arm overrides), each exactly once.

bytes.description: The payload bytes, base64url without padding. sha256 of the decoded bytes must equal contentHash.
